to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

Strengthening NPPA
*141. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of  CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the prices of
essential drugs are fluctuating very fast;
(b) if so, the details of steps taken in
this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority
(NPPA) is unable to control price
fluctuations; and
(d) if so, the remedial  steps taken to
strengthen the NPPA?
Allocation of imported  wheat
*142. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of  CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the allocation of wheat imported,
State-wise; and
(b) the details of quality of
specifications given while importing
wheat?
Chief Ministers' meeting on polio
*143. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had convened a meeting of the Chief
Ministers of those States which have seen
a recent resurgence of polio cases;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that cases of
polio have been reported from many parts
of the country; and
(d) if so, the details of the cases of polio
that have been reported, State-wise?
Brain drain from Railways
†*144. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of  RAILWAYS  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the brilliant
and competent officers of Railways are
leaving Railways  in order to join the private
sector companies;
(b) whether major projects like
dedicated freight corridor are likely to be
affected by this brain drain;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Railways to prevent such exodus;
(d) whether Railways have lowered the
age limit for the Divisional Railway
Manager from 52 years to 50 years; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?
Pesticide contents in cola drinks
*145. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the products of Coca-Cola
and Pepsi-Cola contain pesticides which
are harmful for human consumption;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken against Cola companies for
manufacturing such harmful drinks;
(c) whether the Bureau of Indian
Standards (BIS) has fixed any norms for
the manufacturing of cola drinks and if so,
the details thereof;
(d) whether the cola drinks, available in
the market, meet BIS standards; and
(e) if not, the action taken to stop the
manufacturing/marketing of such harmful
products?
Vaccine for dengue and chikungunya
†*146.  SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
 SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
 Will the Minister of  HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that dengue and
chikungunya/malaria is becoming an
epidemic in the country;
(b) if so, whether Government are going
to invent any vaccine for preventing these
diseases;
(c) whether  Government have
conducted any research in this regard; and
(d) if so, the present status in this
regard?
Availability of professionals in
emergency at the Safdarjung Hospital
*147. SHRI BASHISTHA NARAIN
SINGH: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the medical
professionals like plastic surgeons,
anaesthetists, physiotherapists,
orthopaedic surgeons, etc. were available
round the clock for the treatment of Sarojini
Nagar bomb blast victims and Meerut fire
victims in the Department of Burns and
Plastic Surgery of the Safdarjung Hospital;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a  fact that the
above mentained professionals are also
available on call in the Department of Burns
and Plastic Surgery of that hospital in case
of emergency; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Luxury train from Mumbai to
 Kolkata
*148. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR : Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Railways
have tied up with the Cox and Kings to run
a luxury train from Mumbai to Kolkata;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) how many such trains are being
considered by the Indian Railways Catering
and Tourism Corporation; and

47
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) the details regarding the cost of
introduction of such trains and destinations
thereof?
Commission vendors
*149. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of  RAILWAYS be pleased
to refer to answer to Unstarred Question
543 given in the Rajya Sabha on the 28th
July, 2006 and state:
(a) whether IRCTC has communicated
the letter no. 2004/TG.III/639/2, dated the
1st December, 2005 to the commission
vendors;
(b) if so, the references thereof;
(c) what were the exact terms and
conditions of 'options'; and
(d) whether the commission vendors
are under the administrative control of
IRCTC?
Curbing shortage and black
marketing of fertilizers
†*150. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of  CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 50 per cent
urea and fertilizers, sent to the States under
the Essential Commodities Act, are given
full subsidy;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
the companies dump these fertilizers at
the nearest place due to which these
fertilizers accumulate, in large quantity, at
one place and shortage of the same at other
places prompts black marketing thereof;
and
(c) if so, the steps taken by Government
to do away with this mismanagement?
Procurement of mustard at MSP
†*151. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Government policy on
procurement of mustard on support  price
during 2006-07 and 2007-08;
(b) the difference between the present
support price and that fixed for mustard
for the above said years;
(c) whether the mustard growers in
Rajasthan had to face great difficulties
during the last two years due to the attitude
of Government and NAFED; and
(d) if so, what steps Government would
like to take to do away with their
grievances?
Travelling in the name of the
Members of Parliament
†*152.  SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
   SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of  RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
cases have come to the light during the last
one year in which passengers were caught
travelling in the name of the Members
of Parliament;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are
contemplating to formulate any scheme to
check such frauds; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Defective polio vaccine
*153. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of  HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
continuous increase in the cases of polio in
the country during the last three years;

48
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a number of complaints
regarding defective polio vaccine have been
received against the Bharat Immunological
and Biological Corporation, Bulandshahr,
Uttar Pradesh; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard and
the action taken thereon?
Utilization of unutilized money for
plantation of trees
*154. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
 Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether CAG had audited the
accounts of the Forest Department after
the Supreme Court's directive;
(b) if so, whether CAG has found that
Rs. 1000 crores has nearly been lost in
interest and no money has been utilized by
the States to plant trees and the amount
earmarked therefor is either lying unutilized
or has even been diverted;
(c) if so, whether CAG has observed
total mismanagement in the department;
(d) whether any directive was issued by
the Supreme Court after this report; and
(e) the action Government have taken
to utilize Rs. 2000 crores lying unspent in
the department?
Facilities to control epidemics
*155. SHRI P.R. RAJAN:
SHRI VIJAYKUMAR
RUPANI:
 Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any facility including
separate cell to control epidemic diseases;
(b) if so, the details of such facilities
and the steps taken to strengthen such
facilities as on today, State-wise;
(c) the number of people affected and
died due to dengue fever, chikungunya and
other epidemic diseases for the last three
years, category-wise, State-wise and year-
wise; and
(d) the steps taken, if any, to strengthen
the early detection and cure of above
diseases as on today, State-wise?
Connecting Buddhist centres by rail
lines
*156. SHRI PRAVEEN  RASHTRAPAL:
Will the Minister of  RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether his Ministry is aware that
2550th anniversary of Buddha's
MAHAPARINIRVAN is being celebrated
by Government;
(b) whether there is any request for
operation of special tourist trains to link
Buddhist pilgrim centres during this year;
and
(c) if so, the action being taken thereon?
Revival of SSIs in Gujarat
*157. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of  SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to give any financial package and incentives
for revival of sick SSIs in Gujarat;
(b) if so, the funds allocated for the
purpose for the current year;
(c) the result achieved, so far; and
(d) the total number of SSIs in the State
and the number of those which were sick
as on 31st March, 2006?

49
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Per capita availability of rice and
kerosene oil
†*158. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL:
 DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of  CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of per capita availability
of rice and kerosene oil in the States, as on
date;
(b) whether the said availability is
proportionate to the national average; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Scheduled Tribes (Recognition of
Forests Rights) Bill, 2005
*159. DR. E.M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any conflict between
his Ministry and the Ministry of Tribal
Affairs in bringing The Scheduled Tribes
(Recognition of Forest Rights) Bill, 2005
in the Parliament; and
(b) if not, whether consensus has been
reached in this respect and if so, the status
of the Bill?
Rail Ratna
*160. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of  RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Railways have decided to
enter in the hospitality sector in a big way
by setting up a chain of one hundred hotels
known as "Rail Ratna" at railway stations
across the country by entering into a
partnership with a private group of hotels
who will build and run the three star hotels;
and
(b) if so, how many cities/railway
stations have, so far, been identified, land
deal settled and revenue sharing basis
decided by the Indian Railways Catering
and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) with
the private hotel groups in the country
alongwith the details?

Total number of questions — 155
Assistance for rain deficient States
†1019. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the name of the States of the
Northern India which have less rainfall than
the expected rain fall in the present
monsoon season;
(b) the steps Government have been
taken for the farmers of these States, so
far;
(c) the name of the States where special
packages for farmers have been given due
to no rainfall; and
(d) the details of the fund allocated to
the States, State-wise?
Integrated development of TBOs
1020. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a Central Scheme known as
Integrated Development of Tree Borne
Oilseeds (TBOs) is being implemented
under the Tenth Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the components of the scheme; and
(c) the amount spent on this scheme so
far, State-wise?
Production of pulses
1021. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
production of pulses in the country is not
sufficient to cope up with their demand;
(b) the current level of production and
demand of different pulses and projection
for next five years; and
(c) the steps taken to increase
production of pulses and meanwhile bridge
the gap between demand and supply?
NAIS in Rajasthan
1022. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA : Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the crops presently covered in
Rajasthan under the National Agricultural
Insurance Scheme;
(b) whether the State Government have
sought the intervention of the Central
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

238
Government to include certain other
perennial crops in the scheme;
(c) whether Government would
consider to accord sanction for the above
proposals, if any, and the reaction of
Government thereto;
(d) why a farmer, particularly a marginal
farmer, usually hesitates to undertake an
insurance cover under NAIS and what
hassles he has to face; and
(e) what steps the Central Government
intends to take to help the farmers and the
make NAIS more acceptable and farmer
friendly?
Development of pulses
†1023. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the average production of pulses
viz., moong, urad, arhar, chaula, masoor and
moth before the green revolution and their
present production, State-wise yield per
acre;
(b) whether it is a fact that whole efforts
concentrated on increasing the production
of wheat during the green revolution and
development of pulses remained neglected;
and
(c) the scheme for development of
pulses at present and whether world level
production would be possible from the
same?
Co-ordination Committee on
agricultural development
and policy
1024. SHRI C. RAMACHAN-
DRAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a Co-ordination Committee
has been Constituted to focus on
agricultural development and policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have identified
the key areas that require fresh policy
initiatives; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
National Policy on Farmers
1025. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Commission on Farmers has suggested
Government to formulate a National Policy
on Farmers;
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government in this regard; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Commission had also suggested
Government to focus more on the economic
well being of the farmers feeding the nation?
Making Patwari Halka as an unit
under NAIS
†1026. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL:
SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a proposal has been sent
by the Government of Madhya Pradesh to
the Central Government that Patwari Halka
may be treated as a unit for purposes of
Crop Insurance Scheme;
(b) whether Government have accepted
the proposal; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

239
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and by
when it is likely to be accepted?
Improving farm sector in Punjab
1027. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a study by
International Food Policy Research
Institute has put out red alert on the farm
sector in the heartland of the green
revolution, Punjab;
(b) whether it is also a fact that as per
the study, if Punjab does not diversify from
wheat urgently and more so rice, the food
bowl of India could turn unproductive by
the year 2030; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to improve Punjab’s agricultural
economy?
Tuna fishing in EEZ
1028. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have issued
tender to hire tuna fishing boats to fish in
our EEZ waters;
(b) when this offer was made by
Government to foreign fishing companies;
(c) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken to encourage Indian entrepreneurs to
find finance and funds to start tuna fishing
in our EEZ waters; and
(d) the reasons for neglecting our highly
potential marine fisheries?
Procurement on MSP
†1029. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of wheat, gram, barley
and other foodgrains procured on minimum
support price under Rabi crops during
2006-07;
(b) the quantum of procurement and
storage of these crops on minimum support
price during 2005-06; and
(c) the reasons for this shortfall?
National Horticulture Mission and
National Bamboo Mission
1030. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up a
National Horticulture Mission and also a
National Bamboo Mission with emphasis
and to display the seriousness in unleashing
the tremendous potential for their growth
and development;
(b) if so, the details worked out, so
far;
(c) the present status thereof; and
(d) the aims and objectives set to
achieve under these missions?
Agricultural production
†1031. SHRI KESHUBHAI S. PATEL:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agricultural
production in the country is continuously
decreasing;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of the steps being taken
by Government to increase the agricultural
production in the country?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

240
Use of oldseeds in ISOPOM
1032. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are willing to
allow use of seed varieties of older than ten
years for demonstration in the Centrally
Sponsored Scheme (CSS), Integrated
Scheme of Oilseeds, Pulses, Oil Palm and
Maize (ISOPOM) in a situation where new
varieties are not available; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Growth rate of agriculture
1033. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the growth rate of agriculture
envisaged for the current five year plan;
(b) the growth rate of agriculture
achieved, so far, year-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that agricultural
productivity of the country is very less
than the goals set to be achieved;
(d) whether Government have reviewed
the situation which if allowed to continue
may affect the food security of the country;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the steps
proposed to be taken to increase the
agricultural productivity in the country and
thereby achieving the agricultural growth
rate?
Reduction in duty on import of
wheat
1034. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have waived
the five per cent duty on import of wheat
by private traders to ease pressure on bulk
consumers;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the quantity of wheat which have
been imported after the reduction on duty
and to which extent the price of wheat has
come down in the market?
Production of foodgrains
1035. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to
overcare of industrial development in the
country, a large fertile land has been covered
resulting in a heavy reduction of agricultural
production;
(b) if so, the total production of
foodgrains, rice, pulses, etc. during the
current year, State-wise;
(c) whether this production is in a
position to meet the need of the country;
and
(d) if not, whether Government are
importing wheat, if so, the quantity thereof
and at what prices it shall be supplied to
the common man?

241
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Assistance to State Pesticide Testing
Laboratory
1036. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government will issue
sanction of Rs. 393.00 lakhs during
2006-07 for establishing facilities for
analysis of residues by strengthening and
upgradation of State pesticide testing
laboratory, Durgapura, Jaipur; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Increasing purchasing power of
farmers
†1037. SHRI ALI ANWAR: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the measures Government are taking
to increase purchasing power and income
of the farmers;
(b) the details of scheme of Government
to provide remunerative price of crops to
farmers and to reduce the input cost
thereon;
(c) whether Government have any
scheme in connection to replace the
traditional farming to promote other works
for generating more income; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Subsidy to slaughter-houses
†1038. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are the low incidents
or no incidents of suicides among the
families of farmers where the families have
additional income from livestock;
(b) if so, the justification for setting up
of thousands of slaughter-houses in the
country;
(c) whether slaughter-houses are being
given subsidy; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Rationalizing subsidy under Macro-
Management Scheme
1039. DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether, on the same component,
different rates of assistance are admissible
under different Centrally Sponsored
Schemes (CSSs);
(b) if so, whether Government are
planning to rationalize subsidy pattern
under Macro-Management-work plan to
the extent of fifty per cent; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Estimates of Kharif output
1040. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have released
the first advance estimates of Kharif
foodgrains output for 2006-07, which has
been pegged at 105.22 million tonnes
against the target of 115.25 million tonnes;
(b) if so, whether the shortfall is likely
to be caused by the lower acreage of coarse
cereals and oilseeds;
(c) if so, whether this shortage has
created rise in the prices of coarse cereals
and oilseeds; and
(d)  if so, the steps Government propose
to take to meet the situation?

242
Oilseeds production
†1041. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
continuous decline in the production of
oilseeds in the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that area of
mustard cultivation has declined
considerably during the current year as
compared to the previous year;
(c) whether the main reasons for fall in
area of cultivation of mustard is higher prices
of wheat and gram apart from not getting
the support price for mustard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise
and the steps taken by Government in this
regard, so far?
Making small holdings remunerative
†1042. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as a result of
farmers having small holding in the country,
agriculture has become totally
unremunerative;
(b) whether it is also a fact that in the
absence of necessary infrastructural
facilities, the agriculture sector has not  been
able to develop properly;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
Government’s viewpoint on it; and
(d) whether it is a fact that there is a
need to form land holding companies in the
country?
Futures trading
1043. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Kabra
Committee suggested that the futures
trading should be restricted only to 17
commodities;
(b) if so, the details of those
commodities alongwith the rational for that
recommendation;
(c) whether it is also a fact that at present
80 commodities are being allowed for future/
derivative trading;
(d) whether any Committee set up by
Government recommended for
strengthening of forward Market
Comission;
(e) if so, the steps taken by Government
thereon; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Relaxation in ISOPOM
1044. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are planning
to give relaxation in the implementation of
Centrally Sponsored Scheme-ISOPOM
and Macro-Management-Work Plan; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Strengthening agricultural education
